annotations.title: Age calculator: exact age from a date of birth and the next birthday

description: Exact age from a date of birth in years, months and days, total days lived, the weekday of birth, and the date of and days until the next birthday, measured today (UTC) or on any date you give. Use for age checks, forms and anniversaries. Example: birthdate=1990-05-17. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
